scope: Hosted UX verifier only; no app source, deployed image, cloud configuration or existing account changes

originalFailure.detail: The original hosted failure had no DOM-state diagnostics. An unchanged diagnostic retry passed all nine checks, so the original cause is not claimed as proven.

controlledReproduction.network: Fully intercepted local fixture; no server or live requests

observations: Template search is visible and enabled before the first catalog render
The input event invokes renderWorkFormsList; changed identity scope resets the typed query
With two active fixtures, both cards remain and the original exact-count symptom is reproduced

controlledReproduction.preFixResult: Failed the verifier readiness regression: fill attempted with zero rendered cards, before the initial catalog barrier

controlledReproduction.knownUserExperienceLimitation: A very early search interaction on initial load can lose its query before identity-scoped initialization finishes. This is a minor real UI timing limitation, not solely a verifier defect; app code remains unchanged in this release.
